description: This file defines functions to build and configure embedded extensions for an agent system, including context pruning and compaction safeguard extensions, based on configuration and runtime models.

methods.name: resolveContextWindowTokens
methods.description: Calculates the number of context window tokens based on configuration and model info.

methods.name: buildContextPruningFactory
methods.description: Builds a context pruning extension factory if configuration and provider eligibility criteria are met.

methods.name: resolveCompactionMode
methods.description: Determines the compaction mode ('default' or 'safeguard') based on configuration.

methods.name: buildEmbeddedExtensionFactories
methods.description: Builds a list of extension factories, including safeguard and pruning, based on configuration.
